deadline_meaning: physical-phone assisted pilot handoff; actual shop field visit occurs later

resources.model_token_budget: user has not imposed a token cap
resources.paid_provider_budget: use configured authorized services within known quota; token permission is not a purchase authorization

evidence_contract.nonapplicable_receipt_field: explicit null with reason; never invented identifiers
verification: hash and size actual bytes; parse expected format and verify semantics
rerun behavioral assertions or recompute metrics from actual artifacts
check dependency closure including dirty files and frozen evaluation manifest
validate scan/revision/owner identity against runtime/API, not receipt prose
preserve failures, exclusions, abstentions and all denominator items
secret-free logs; provider credentials never included
no pass from process exit zero without required behavioral assertions

gates.name: Evidence integrity and ownership
requires: frozen policy/contracts
exact file leases
source/capture snapshots
receipt validator rejects false evidence
all required adversarial mutations killed behaviorally

gates.name: Correct baseline and integrated code
requires: combine-floor regression repaired without mutating originals
protruding-shelf regression repaired
relevant API/pipeline/contracts/agents suites pass
web typecheck tests and production build pass
no required test replaced by skip/xfail
generated schema parity

gates.name: Complete capture receipt and reliable jobs
requires: server validates bytes and frame/pose/intrinsics/mesh associations
semantic job waits for complete required bundle
late evidence queues exactly one derived job
identical replay no duplicate nodes or revisions
crash/restart recovery and visible errors
legacy geometry-only state explicitly incomplete for semantics

gates.name: Semantic integration and trustworthy evidence
requires: production calls discovery and secondary semantic correction
all four target classes plus sofa/table/whiteboard regressions
source crops decode and map to original sensor pixels
measured/inferred/unlocalized support separated
occlusion and neighboring outlets preserved
manual and automatic provenance distinct
gates.note: Component/provenance gate, not measured real-world detector accuracy. Image-only unknown candidates are allowed and visibly unlocalized.

gates.name: Persistent human review and revision safety
requires: confirm reject correct and manual mark save via authenticated API
reload and rediscovery preserve owner decisions
late stale job cannot overwrite review
concurrent conflicting revision edit is explicit
changed role/evidence/transform/scenario invalidates affected derived results

gates.name: Numerical geometry and uncertainty semantics
requires: nonidentity frame transforms roundtrip consistently
camera corner verification including principal point and image orientation
measurement provenance and unknown uncertainty preserved
no double transform across scene collision and exports
threshold-straddling values cannot pass
gates.note: Numerical tolerances validate implementation only; they are not sensor accuracy bounds. Actual metric accuracy requires G17.

gates.name: Complete visible scoped assessment
requires: immutable hashed scope manifest frozen before assessment with surveyed/unobserved areas routes classes known item IDs requested rules applicability questions and denominator rows
scope changes version and invalidate dependent certificates; unresolved class/area obligations retained
all manifest item/rule combinations have explicit outcome
Unevaluated visible as needs_verification
unsupported/restroom/operational conditions remain visible
legal applicability/source/review separated from numerical calculation
preview/unreviewed ledger cannot become verified legal conclusion

gates.name: Approach and redesign invariants
requires: connected approach and swept wheelchair occupancy
uncertain reach stays uncertain
fixed fixtures excluded from furniture moves
proposal has immutable parent and new candidate revision
same scope remeasured/rechecked before promotion
improvement exceeds relevant uncertainty
no proposal claimed when no supported solution exists
gates.note: Transparent synthetic solution cases prove mechanics; actual-scene recommendation needs actual-scene evidence.

gates.name: Coherent review UI and exports
requires: object->crop->map navigation for target classes
manual fallback and clear missing-object states
all outcomes and unknowns visible
before/after report and ZIP agree with pinned API state
keyboard/focus/touch/mobile layout checks
map/photos usable when mesh unavailable

gates.name: Authorization and usable runtime
requires: owning user completes actual HTTP journey
anonymous/other-user crop graph review and export access denied
path traversal and malicious artifact rejected
restart preserves coherent state
single worker per DB
actual declared runtime dependencies verified
documented local/portable network and unavailable feature behavior

gates.name: Real Moffett production replay
requires: real stored capture bytes through production processing
successful actual detector invocation with provider/runtime metadata and actual output, which may legitimately be empty
candidate graph and evidence rows read from authenticated API
actual crops inspected
real review and scoped report saved under new revision
original hashes unchanged
gates.pass_condition: Successful real processing and truthful outputs, including a legitimate empty detector result; detector failure blocks this gate. Automatic accuracy and presence claims require separate G12.

gates.name: Tonight physical-phone pilot
requires: actual installed iPhone build identity
fresh small-room capture not a replay
complete upload and derived evidence graph
review available target objects with actual crops and manual fallback
confirm role/route and inspect selected check/report
interrupt/resume exercise without data loss
phone reachable runtime and field startup instructions
gates.note: Undetected target classes default to unobserved. Absence may only be recorded with an independent human inventory covering the declared area; it cannot silently remove scope questions. Their controls are tested on separate fixtures. Never plant fabricated detections. This is not the actual boba-shop visit.

gates.name: Automatic semantics evaluated against predeclared benchmark targets
requires: independent human-reviewed held-out object inventory
at least three distinct sites not used for tuning
unique physical object denominators and explicit negative regions
no manual corrections counted as automatic
all false positives misses and abstentions reported
binomial uncertainty reported per class
unknown/unobserved areas reported separately
gates.note: Engineering entry targets, not proof of universal accuracy or statistically guaranteed 95% performance. Insufficient samples stay pending. Assisted pilot can pass without G12; automated-accuracy claims cannot.

gates.name: Moffett scoped evidence dossier
requires: actual latest candidate revision pinned
scope/applicability matrix covers requested accessibility questions
all outcome records have source/provenance or exact missing-input reason
rule source/version and legal-review status exposed
Moffett control-measurement gaps explicit
recapture and human verification list
before/after recommendations only where justified
gates.note: A complete evidence dossier can truthfully contain violations and unknowns. This gate never means the requirements are all satisfied.

gates.name: Evidence supports particular scoped requirements
requires: named requirements and item identities fixed in hashed scope manifest before conclusion
applicable legal source/edition/context confirmed
qualified independent human review of every claimed requirement's applicability jurisdiction edition exceptions and evidence sufficiency
sufficient measured and operational evidence for every condition
no missing exceptions or unresolved threshold uncertainty
qualified reviewer attribution authentic
gates.note: Requirement-level result, not a whole-site certificate. A true violation means this satisfaction gate remains failed for that requirement while the assessment itself succeeds. Do not optimize reality to pass.

gates.name: Photo mesh 500px quality
requires: all applicable gates in referenced visual policy recomputed
frozen source-independent test views and exposure disclosure
actual mesh in product viewer
all four Moffett rooms and full-floor seated route
physical-phone runtime for phone claim
independent visual review; user acceptance separate
gates.note: Reference policy remains authoritative for further details; mismatch between policies fails preflight. Any authorized change requires versioning. A library runtime candidate cannot inherit a single-room proof.

gates.name: Actual new-shop field journey
requires: new boba-shop capture with permission and real network/offline conditions recorded
owner/user reviews actual target inventory and public route/counter/restroom context
every selected item located or explicitly unobserved
specific evidence-backed screening output and remaining questions
actual user phone walkthrough and export
supported redesign if opportunity exists, otherwise honest no-supported-proposal
gates.note: Cannot be completed before visiting. Does not prove all shop requirements satisfied or automatic detector accuracy. Physical-control conclusions require G17.

gates.name: Independent metric accuracy for declared measurements
requires: independent field controls with instrument/method/actor/time
calibration controls separate from withheld check controls
measurement-type-specific withheld controls for each claim
raw discrepancies and conservative individual measurement bounds
each threshold conclusion has adequate individual evidence with margin beyond its bound; aggregate metrics cannot override it
all poor/near-threshold observations retained
no general sensor or scene accuracy claim from this small empirical sample
gates.note: Engineering screening targets, not ADA tolerances or certified confidence intervals. At least 10 controls with 5 held out, and adequate controls for each claimed method; insufficient category coverage stays pending for that category. Every actual legal dimension still needs a defensible bound and all relevant evidence; passing aggregate error cannot override a bad critical measurement.

automatic_semantics_benchmark_passed.scope: only the frozen benchmark and its declared sample counts, not universal product accuracy

scoped_requirements_satisfied.scope: only individually named requirements with complete evidence; never whole site

whole_site_ADA_compliance.note: May store an authentic site-specific professional assessment with its scope and limitations; software cannot issue this blanket conclusion.

scoring.aggregation: logical conjunction of required gates and their transitive dependencies
scoring.progress_display: counts of independently evidenced gates and named blockers, never percent ADA compliant
scoring.qualitative_review: explicit reviewer identity and per-view/per-item notes; not a made-up numeric score
scoring.policy_thresholds: proposed engineering acceptance targets, not observed results or legal tolerances
